claims: Dawn Staley is the South Carolina coach.

Dawn Staley's contract increases by $250,000 annually.
Dawn Staley's contract has a total value of approximately $25.25 million over 4 years on top of her previous deal.

Dawn Staley's contract includes an annual escalator of $250,000 increase per year.
Dawn Staley's contract compensation is set to reach $5.25 million by 2029-30.

Dawn Staley's contract includes a $250,000 performance incentive for national championship.
